description: Structured Housebreaking & Theft FIR with header and full metadata
text:
FIRST INFORMATION REPORT
(Under Section 154 Cr.P.C. / 173 BNSS)
1. District: Khordha    P.S.: Khandagiri    Year: 2026    FIR No.: 0048/2026
2. Acts & Sections: BNS 2023 - Sec 303(2), Sec 305
3. Occurrence of Offence: Date: 15/08/2026 Time: 23:30 hrs
4. Complainant: Rajesh Kumar s/o Mohan Lal, Mob: 9876543210, r/o House 42, Khandagiri
5. Details of Suspect: Ramesh and Suresh
6. Details of Witnesses: Witness Suresh saw suspects fleeing
7. Brief Details: The complainant reported that at around 11:30 PM, suspects broke rear door lock, entered his residence at Khandagiri, brandished a knife, and stole gold ornaments worth Rs. 2,00,000/- and cash of Rs. 50,000/-. Getaway vehicle was OD-02-AB-1234.

On 12-08-2024 at around 10:45 PM, Priyadarshi Mohanty lodged a complaint at Saheed Nagar Police Station. He stated that while returning home near Saheed Nagar, two unknown motorcycle riders on OR-02-X-9999 blocked his path, threatened him at gunpoint with a pistol, and snatched his iPhone and wallet containing Rs. 15,000 cash. Eyewitness Amit Kumar witnessed the crime from a nearby shop.

FIR No.: 0102/2026
P.S.: Capital Police Station
Complainant: Deepak Roy
Accused: Suresh Mohapatra
Details: Accused Suresh Mohapatra attacked complainant Deepak Roy with a sharp dagger near Market Building at around 09:15 PM on 18-08-2026 intending to kill him. Victim sustained deep abdominal stab injuries and was rushed to Capital Hospital by witness Manoj Das.

FIR Date: 20/08/2026
P.S.: Cyber Crime PS
Complainant: Sunita Sharma, Phone: 9123456789
Details: Complainant received a deceptive phishing SMS link mimicking income tax refund portal on WhatsApp. Cyber fraudsters illegally withdrew Rs. 1,50,000 from her SBI bank account.

FIR No.: 0099/2026
P.S.: Mangalabag Police Station
Complainant: Subhash Chandra
Accused: Alok Verma
Details: Accused employee Alok Verma submitted forged medical reimbursement bills and fake hospital receipts, cheating the company of Rs. 3,50,000/-.

P.S.: Mahila Police Station, Cuttack
Complainant: Meena Kumari
Accused: Husband Ramesh and In-laws
Details: Complainant reported that her husband Ramesh and mother-in-law mentally and physically tortured her demanding a luxury car and Rs. 5,00,000 in cash dowry.

FIR No.: 0215/2026
P.S.: Tamando PS
Complainant: Bikram Swain, Mob: 9988776655
Details: Complainant parked his Hyundai i20 car bearing registration number OD-02-Z-5555 outside his residence on 22-08-2026 at 10:00 PM. Next morning at 06:00 AM, the vehicle was missing. Unidentified thieves stole the car.
